query: Run /audit on this diff before we merge. File routes/documents.js: 'app.delete("/api/documents/:id", authenticate, async (req, res) => { const doc = await Document.findById(req.params.id); await doc.remove(); res.json({ success: true }); });' Tests pass and the PR description says 'adds delete endpoint for documents, straightforward.' Approve it?
expected_behavior: Names the defect explicitly: the delete handler checks that the requester is authenticated but never verifies they own or are authorized to delete that specific document, an insecure direct object reference
Classifies the finding as P0 (BLOCKER): an authorization bypass on a destructive, data-loss endpoint
Runs the Algorithm's authorization model audit step rather than offering only an ad hoc opinion on the snippet
Explicitly states REJECT (Changes Requested), not APPROVE, despite the passing tests and the 'straightforward' PR description
Prescribes the concrete fix direction: verify the document's owner (or an equivalent role/permission check) matches the requesting user before calling remove()
